mapper.insert: INSERT INTO migration_project (name, customer_name, source_env, target_env, status, planned_date) VALUES (#{name}, #{customerName}, #{sourceEnv, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{targetEnv, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status}, #{plannedDate, jdbcType=DATE})

INSERT INTO asset (project_id, name, asset_type, role, os_name, os_version) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{name}, #{assetType}, #{role, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{osName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{osVersion, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
INSERT INTO asset_ip (asset_id, address, ip_type, phase, ext_whitelisted, note) VALUES (#{assetId}, #{address}, #{ipType}, #{phase}, #{extWhitelisted}, #{note, jdbcType=VARCHAR})

INSERT INTO dependency (project_id, from_asset_id, to_asset_id, target_address, target_port, protocol, config_location) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{fromAssetId}, #{toAssetId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{targetAddress}, #{targetPort}, #{protocol}, #{configLocation, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
INSERT INTO dns_record (project_id, domain, record_type, value, ttl, phase) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{domain}, #{recordType}, #{value}, #{ttl}, #{phase})
INSERT INTO certificate (project_id, domain, issuer, not_after, phase) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{domain}, #{issuer, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{notAfter, jdbcType=DATE}, #{phase})
INSERT INTO asset_software (asset_id, product, role, version, release_line, phase) VALUES (#{assetId}, #{product}, #{role, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{version}, #{releaseLine}, #{phase})
INSERT INTO backup_plan (asset_id, last_backup_at, restore_tested, offsite, phase) VALUES (#{assetId}, #{lastBackupAt, jdbcType=DATE}, #{restoreTested}, #{offsite}, #{phase})
